## Change

Describe the user-visible result and the problem it solves.

## Scientific scope

For scientific content or demos: identify the status label, sources, assumptions, units, and limitations. Write “not applicable” for changes without scientific content.

## Verification

List checks actually performed. For UI changes, include the affected desktop/mobile and Chinese/English checks, plus screenshots where useful.

- [ ] `npm run check` (for code changes)
- [ ] `npm run validate:registry` (for registry changes)
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or unlicensed assets added
- [ ] New claims and AI-assisted material reviewed for accuracy and attribution

## Remaining limitations

Mention anything intentionally incomplete or not verified.
